turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to take an art class this spring and I can't pick one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll go through the options one by one. Don't say anything until I finish.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is a six week watercolor course at the community center, pretty cheap, Tuesday nights.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a figure drawing class downtown with live models, but it's twice the price.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is an online oil painting course I could do whenever I want from home.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all the options. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The watercolor course is the easiest start and the cheapest. Figure drawing will improve your skills fastest, but only if the price doesn't bother you. The online oil course is flexible, though it's easy to lose motivation without a teacher in the room.
